<!--
Read .github/CONTRIBUTING.md first. A pull request from a fork is read as a
proposal: if its idea fits, it's rebuilt on a branch of ours, credited to you.
Solve one problem. Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as
"fix(web): new threads no longer spike CPU".
-->

## Problem

<!-- The problem in a sentence or two: what you expected, what happened, and
how to reproduce it. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes it, and why each part is needed for the same fix. -->

## Verification

<!-- The tests or checks you ran and what you saw. Before/after screenshots
for UI changes. Leave out secrets and home folder paths. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
